_meta.description: API-Football national team IDs for the 48 WC26 squads. Populated by scripts/04_discover_api_football_team_ids.py (one-time, requires API_FOOTBALL_KEY).
_meta.format: Each TLA maps to an int (the team's API-Football ID) or null if not yet discovered. The refresh script skips teams with null IDs and logs a warning.
